The model disagreement between short-term bullish signals (7d, 14d) and longer-term bearish outlook (21d champion model) reflects this transition period where technical momentum conflicts with fundamental positioning. VIX at 18.07 in unknown state suggests volatility is elevated but direction uncertain, making this a critical inflection point.
